title: Windows 11 Fax application architecture & HP M283cdw integration roadmap
content:
Explored architecture and system requirements for building a dedicated Windows 11 desktop fax suite integrating directly with the hardware HP Color LaserJet Pro MFP M283cdw.

Key architectural foundations:

  • Hardware & Modem Integration: Mapped the printer's onboard 33.6 kbps analog fax modem (RJ-11 1-LINE / 2-EXT ports) and VoIP ATA pass-through options for direct physical line transmission.
  • Dual Inbound/Outbound Engine: Leveraged HP Digital Fax (EWS Fax-to-Network-Folder) to automatically save incoming faxes as PDFs into a watched folder, paired with the HP PC Fax spooler driver for automated outbound document transmission.
  • Windows 11 Desktop Suite: Outlined a React + Tauri/Electron desktop architecture incorporating Billionaire's telephony sanitization and hybrid vanity word matching, local SQLite audit storage, embedded PDF preview, and Windows 11 Toast notifications.
